title: Framing Cleaning before Walls Close on Reconstruction Drywall and Insulation Lines
content:
Before a drywall or insulation line on a Reconstruction change order closes walls over framing the loss reached, the framing is cleaned at the rate of the company mitigation job that preceded the rebuild at the same loss, on the quantity written on the proposal, the wall area the line closes. The cleaning is the cleaning rate times that quantity and is charged on the line.

**Cleaning rate by preceding company job.**

| Preceding company job recorded on the contract | Cleaning rate |
|---|---|
| a Water Damage Mitigation job assessed category 3 | that water job tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot |
| a Fire & Smoke Mitigation job | that fire job tier's wet cleaning rate per square foot |
| a Mold Remediation job | that mold job tier's HEPA vacuuming rate per square foot |

Every other line, and a drywall or insulation line with no such preceding job, carries no cleaning; a water job assessed category 1 or category 2 is not such a job.

## Applying the rule

| Line | Preceding company job | Cleaning |
|---|---|---|
| drywall or insulation | water job, category 3 | HEPA vacuuming rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | fire job | wet cleaning rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | mold job | HEPA vacuuming rate times the quantity written |
| drywall or insulation | water job, category 1 or 2, or no preceding job | none |
| any other line | any | none |

## Example (hypothetical rate)

An insulation line written for 340 square feet on a rebuild that followed a fire job whose tier's wet cleaning rate is assumed at $0.35 per square foot carries a cleaning of $119.00.
